I will do whatever is necessary to achieve that goal, and I will allow nothing and no one to stand in my way.|Thrawn||audio=TheSoleReasonForMyExistence-LesserEvil.flac}} '''Mitth'raw'nuruodo''', [[Reproduction|born]] as '''Kivu'raw'nuru''' with the [[core name]] '''Vurawn''', recognized in his early military career as '''Mitth'raw'nuru''', and better known by his core name '''Thrawn''', was a [[Chiss]] [[Gender|male]] [[officer]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy]] and [[Grand Admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era|age]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. An [[alien]] [[Imperial officer]] with striking [[Color|blue]] skin, red [[eye]]s, and an angular face, Grand [[Admiral]] Thrawn was well known as a brilliant and ruthless strategist. He believed that in order to achieve victory in war, one must know their enemy. As such, Thrawn dedicated himself to understanding the philosophy, art, and culture of his opponents, which included the [[Grysk Hegemony]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[New Republic]]. Before joining the [[Imperial Military]], Thrawn served with the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet|Expansionary Defense Fleet]] of the Chiss Ascendancy. A [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[Rentor]], located in the [[Unknown Regions]] of [[the galaxy]], Thrawn served in the [[Ascendancy military]] with both valor and controversy. [[Patriarch]]s [[Mitth'oor'akiord]] ("Thooraki") and [[Stybla'mi'ovodo]] ("Lamiov"), leaders of the Chiss [[Mitth family|Mitth]] and [[Stybla family|Stybla]] [[Chiss family|families]] respectively, worked with [[General]] [[Ba'kif]], founder of the Expansionary Defense [[Fleet]], to [[Rematching|adopt]] Thrawn into the Mitth family and guide his career and training in the Fleet. Thooraki, Lamiov, and Ba'kif also worked together to guide Thrawn into a close friendship with [[Mitth'ras'safis]] ("Thrass")—a Chiss man whose [[Politics|political]] talents complemented Thrawn's analytical and strategic skills in warfare. Thrawn, who did not form friendships easily, grew close to Thrass, and, in [[time]], the two [[Mission to Pleknok|came to regard]] each other as brothers. Thrawn went on to lead [[Vagaari pirate operations|anti-piracy operations]] against a [[Vagaari pirates|group]] of [[pirate]]s known as the [[Vagaari]], which saw the tragic [[death]] of Thrawn's brother Thrass. Near the end of the [[Clone Wars]], in around [[19 BBY]], the warlike [[Grysk]] Hegemony began a [[Jixtus's plan|plot to destroy the Chiss Ascendancy]]. First, they groomed and trained a [[Nikardun]] general named [[Yiv]] who ruled the [[Nikardun Destiny]], an expansionist empire in the Unknown Regions. The Grysk agent "[[Jixtus]]" sent Yiv to [[Nikardun conquests|conquer or intimidate]] the [[Paataatus Hiveborn|nations]] [[Lioaoin Regime|neighboring]] the Ascendancy to [[Tower Dimension|encircle]] the Chiss, who [[Non-intervention policy|could not launch attacks]] on anyone who had not directly attacked the Ascendancy. Thrawn left his native Unknown Regions and traveled to known [[Realspace|space]] to search for allies against Yiv. There, he encountered the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] during the Clone Wars and fought alongside Skywalker during a [[Mission to Mokivj|mission]] to [[Mokivj]]. Shortly thereafter, Thrawn was instrumental in [[Battle over Primea|defeating]] [[Primea fleet|Yiv's fleet]], leading to the demise of the Nikardun Destiny. Following Yiv's defeat, Jixtus [[Agbui attempt to precipitate a Chiss Ascendancy civil war|dispatched a group]] of the [[Telepathy|telepathic]] [[Agbui]] species to manipulate Chiss [[Xodlak'uvi'vil|officials]] of three of the Ascendancy's [[Great Families]] into starting a civil war in the Ascendancy. Thrawn was instrumental in [[Hoxim incident|defusing the Agbui plot]] above the planet [[Hoxim]]. After the Agbui's failure to instigate a civil war in the Ascendancy, Jixtus enlisted the service of the [[Kilji Illumine]] to [[Grysk plot to engineer a Chiss civil war|undermine the Ascendancy from within]] and [[Attack on the Illumine Kilhorde|close nations]] to the Southeast of the Ascendancy from Chiss [[refugee]]s who would survive the war he hoped to foment. Aware of the [[Grysk armada]]'s superior firepower to the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, Thrawn and his friends arranged for [[Vak Combine|several]] [[Garwian Unity|allied]] [[Paccian Governance|nations]] to unite and defeat [[Jixtus's fleet]] in a climactic battle over the planet [[Sunrise]] known as [[Senior Captain Thrawn's last stand]]. Defeating the Grysks took a tremendous toll on Thrawn's career. Many political adversaries wanted him stripped of his rank and [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]]. [[Supreme General]] Ba'kif, fearing the loss of his "Golden egg," decided he would let Thrawn go into exile, but in exile, Thrawn would attempt to go to [[Galactic Empire]] and study it as the Chiss needed allies for the coming war with the Grysks, for their return was imminent, and Supreme General Ba'kif thought that the Galactic Empire might be of good use. After stowing away on a [[Star Destroyer]], Thrawn offered his allegiance to [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and the Empire. With the help of [[Imperial cadet]] [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]], Thrawn assimilated into [[Galaxy|galactic]] society, becoming fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard]] and ultimately graduating from the [[Royal Imperial Academy]] on [[Coruscant]] in only three [[Standard month|months]]. His career in the [[Navy]] was highly successful; Cadet Vanto became Thrawn's aide and protégé. All the while, Thrawn also recruited [[Morgan Elsbeth]] to his cause as one of his most loyal followers. After several promotions, he received the [[Military rank|rank]] of Grand Admiral from the Emperor himself. At the height of his career, Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn served as [[commanding officer]] of the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]], the [[flagship]] of which was the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]''. A few [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Action at Mustafar|start]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]], when [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] requested a strong [[commander]] capable of defeating the [[Phoenix Cell|rebels]] on [[Lothal]], Thrawn accepted the challenge, intending to [[Lothal campaign|dismantle]] the Rebellion one piece at a time. Deployed to the [[Lothal sector]], he sought to defeat the rebels led by [[Captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]]. During his leadership of the Seventh Fleet, Thrawn proposed and staunchly advocated for a new [[starfighter]]-[[bomber]]: Morgan Elsbeth's [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]], which was to be initially manufactured on Lothal before being mass-produced throughout the galaxy. Following the [[Battle of Atollon]] against the rebels, Emperor Palpatine summoned Grand Admiral Thrawn to his palace to undertake a mission with the Emperor's [[Sith apprentice]] [[Darth]] Vader, whom Thrawn once knew as the [[Jedi]] Anakin Skywalker. Palpatine considered Thrawn and Vader his two most useful servants and believed his [[Mission to Batuu (Galactic Empire)|mission]] would require the unique talents and knowledge of both men. In the ensuing mission, Thrawn's fleet worked with Vader's [[1st Legion|First Legion]] and ultimately [[Battle of Mokivj|rescued]] several [[Force-sensitive]] Chiss [[Youngling|girls]] held captive by the warlike Grysk species. Soon thereafter, Thrawn took on a mission to defend the supply lines of [[Project Stardust]] from apparent losses to electronics-eating [[gralloc]]s. The true culprits of the losses were the treasonous Grand Admiral [[Balanhai Savit]] and, separately, a force of Grysks seeking to conquer Imperial space and perhaps control the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. After exposing Savit's treason and defeating that Grysk force, Thrawn resumed his task of eliminating Syndulla's rebel cell on Lothal. Syndulla's rebels confronted Thrawn's forces with the intention of [[Liberation of Lothal|liberating Lothal]] once and for all. During the battle, a flock of [[purrgil]] came to the aid of Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] and inflicted heavy damage on the Seventh Fleet. Thrawn was on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of his [[command ship]] when the creatures surrounded the ''Chimaera'' and pulled it into [[hyperspace]], taking both Thrawn and Bridger to the [[extragalactic]] planet [[Peridea]], where they would remain in exile. In the years following Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn's disappearance, both the Emperor and Vader were killed at the [[Battle of Endor]], the Empire was decisively beaten at the [[Battle of Jakku]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was [[Declaration of a New Republic|reorganized]] into the New Republic. In spite of his vanishing and unconfirmed death at Lothal years prior, the [[Imperial Remnant]] prepared for Thrawn's return as "heir to the Empire". Former Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano]] began hearing whispers of his return and began searching for him in [[9 ABY]], which led her to face Thrawn's protégée Elsbeth. With the help of Peridea's [[Great Mothers]] [[Nightsisters]], Elsbeth travelled to Thrawn pursued by Tano, and after [[Battle of Peridea|fending Tano off]], Thrawn escaped Peridea, though unbeknownst to him, so did Ezra Bridger. Free from his exile, Thrawn and the Great Mothers traveled to the Nightsister homeworld of [[Dathomir]] and prepared to fight the New Republic. Even in his absence, Thrawn's talents benefited the New Order. His knowledge of the Unknown Regions proved essential to [[Unknown Regions Imperial remnant|loyalists]] that retreated from the known galaxy, helping them survive in unexplored space where they eventually formed the [[First Order]], a major part of Emperor Palpatine's [[Contingency]] plan.
